title: Arawak settle the island
description: The Taíno people settle Jamaica and call it Xaymaca, meaning land of wood and water.

title: Columbus lands
description: On his second voyage Columbus anchors at Discovery Bay and claims the island for Spain.

title: First Spanish capital
place: Sevilla la Nueva, St Ann's Bay
description: Juan de Esquivel founds Sevilla la Nueva, the first Spanish settlement and first capital of the island.

title: English invasion
description: Penn and Venables land a Parliamentary armada and take the island from Spain; a few hundred Spanish abandon it within days.

title: Port Royal earthquake
description: A great earthquake sinks two-thirds of Port Royal, the richest and wickedest city in the English Americas, into the sea.

title: Maroon treaty
description: Britain signs peace treaties with the Maroons, the escaped slaves who had fought the army to a standstill in the mountains.

title: Tacky's War
description: The largest slave revolt in the British Caribbean before 1791 is put down after five months; Tacky is shot dead.

title: Baptist War
description: Sixty thousand slaves join Samuel Sharpe's Christmas strike, the largest slave uprising in the British West Indies, hastening the end of slavery.

title: Morant Bay rebellion
description: A protest led by Paul Bogle turns into an uprising; Governor Eyre's reprisals kill hundreds and cause an empire-wide scandal.

title: Crown colony government
description: The old House of Assembly votes itself out of existence and Jamaica becomes a crown colony under direct British rule.

title: Kingston earthquake
description: An earthquake and fire destroy much of Kingston and kill around a thousand people.

title: Garvey founds the UNIA
description: Marcus Garvey founds the Universal Negro Improvement Association, which becomes the largest black organisation in history.

title: Labour rebellion
description: Cane workers' protests at Frome set off island-wide riots, the breakthrough that births the trade unions and the two national parties.

title: Universal suffrage
description: Jamaica holds its first election with universal adult suffrage, the first British Caribbean colony to do so.

title: Federation referendum
description: Voters choose to leave the West Indies Federation, dooming the federation and sending Jamaica to independence alone.

title: Independence
description: Jamaica becomes an independent state after more than three centuries of British rule.

title: Coral Gardens
description: Police raids on Rastafari at Coral Gardens trigger a rebellion and prove a turning point in state relations with the movement.

title: Haile Selassie visits
description: Ethiopia's emperor is mobbed by one hundred thousand Rastafari at the airport and counsels patience; the day is marked as Grounation Day.

title: One Love Peace Concert
description: Bob Marley makes Manley and Seaga clasp hands on stage during the peace concert that defines reggae's political moment.

title: Bloody election year
description: Edward Seaga's Labour Party wins the most violent election in national history, several hundred having died in the campaign.

title: Hurricane Gilbert
description: The strongest Atlantic hurricane then recorded roars the length of the island, wrecking crops and half the houses.

title: Portia Simpson-Miller prime minister
description: Portia Simpson-Miller is sworn in as Jamaica's first female prime minister.

title: Kingston unrest
description: The army storms Tivoli Gardens to capture the don Christopher Coke for extradition, killing scores of civilians in four days.
